The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.

To understand how search engines work, imagine the Internet as a massive, infinite library. In this analogy, each website is like a specific book on the shelves, and the individual web pages within that site are the pages inside the book. If you are looking for a specific piece of information, you wouldn't want to read every book from cover to cover. Instead, you would use the library’s index or catalog system to locate the exact book and page that contains what you need. Search engines like Google function as this digital index, helping you quickly navigate the vast library of the Internet to find the precise website and page that holds the answer to your query.
